children.innerHTML: A wood-fired dining experience in the heart of San Francisco.

Where the open hearth
meets the season's best.
Every dish at Ember begins with a fire and a question: what does this ingredient need? We source from farms within 100 miles, adjust our menu weekly, and let the flame do most of the talking.
Ember opened in 2019 with one wood-burning oven, a handful of local farmers, and a simple idea: fire makes everything better. We haven't changed our mind.
Reservations are strongly recommended. Walk-ins welcome at the bar.
